title: A/P Summary: a report that fails to load says so in place of the rows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Switch the network back on.
  4. Change the as-of date back to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 2:

  • The report tries to load and fails: in place of the rows it shows "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again.", with the standard error message as well.

Step 3:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 4:

  • The report loads normally again.

A server error cannot be caused by hand; a lost connection is the failure a tester can cause.
